# ServerSync (vendored)

`ConfigSync.cs` and `LICENSE.txt` are copied unchanged from
https://github.com/blaxxun-boop/ServerSync (MIT-0), the library CLLC and the other Smoothbrain mods
use for version checks and server-enforced configs. CLLC Extended compiles it as source instead of
merging its DLL with ILRepack (its JetBrains annotations come from UnityEngine.CoreModule).
To update: copy the new `ConfigSync.cs` from that repository.
